description: Boring, weekly-only Renovate config for this repo.

Watches: GitHub Actions in .github/workflows/, the Helm chart pins in kubernetes/helmfile.yaml.gotmpl (native helmfile manager), ansible/requirements.txt (native pip manager), and through the customManagers below every other pin: bare `image:` lines in kubernetes/services/, the busybox digest wherever it is copied, k3s / helm / helmfile / helm-diff (group_vars), helm-unittest (Makefile), and the Ansible collections' git tags.
Every pin has one home; CI reads it from there rather than holding a copy.
Not watched: kubeconform and gitleaks (their SHA256 pins cannot be bumped by Renovate), Debian and Tailscale (unattended-upgrades and apt).
Automerge is disabled everywhere: every update lands as a PR for manual review.

customManagers.description: Bare image pins in platform-service and app-chart values files.
helm, pinned in group_vars (validate.yaml reads it from there).
helmfile, pinned in group_vars (validate.yaml reads it from there).
helm-unittest, pinned in the Makefile (validate.yaml reads it from there).
Ansible collections, installed from their GitHub tags (ansible/requirements.yml says why).
The busybox init image, pinned by digest in the app chart, two values files and the chart's snapshot: one PR moves every copy.

packageRules.description: ClickHouse stays on the 26.3 LTS line: 26.5 and 26.7 break OpenPanel (op-clickhouse.yaml).
PostgreSQL 18 changes the image's data layout; a major is a dump/restore (docs/guides/operate.md).
Redis 8: no support statement from OpenPanel or BullMQ (docs/guides/operate.md, Version decisions).
